release_notes: Pigeon Poker 1.5.10 fixes live paid preflop range matching across all 174 source situations. When a live action history omits raise-to amounts, the resolver now matches the exact ordered actor/action history and safely disambiguates same-action nodes using the live pot and amount-to-call. Known incorrect raise sizes remain rejected, and ambiguous or mismatched source histories do not produce a paid chart. The BOT and paid range viewer continue to share the same source scenario and 169-hand matrix. Verification covers all 174 situations, all 169 hand classes, omitted raise-size histories, wrong-size rejection, Windows native Tk rendering, and updater package extraction.
